integrity: Analytic proof with a quantitative bound and reproducible finite diagnostics; numerical tests do not certify an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Finite-state irreducible reversible propulsion chain, stationary heading initialization and positive thermal diffusivity are assumed.
Only the finite positive scaled-time-window average is proved; no pointwise instantaneous entropy-production limit is claimed.
The full joint-state even-orientation entropy-production convention is essential; alternative parity conventions may differ.
The work has not undergone independent scientific audit.
title: Universal weak-confinement entropy-production crossover for reversible Markov propulsion
